plan: Given my private value of $31, my goal is to maximize profit by winning the auction at a cost lower than my value. To win, I should bid slightly above average expected bids to secure the prize but still ensure a profit. A reasonable bid is slightly above the midpoint of the range, considering my value and potential bids from others. I will bid $28 to balance winning chances and potential profit, assuming others bid closer to their values or slightly below the midpoint.

Given my high private value of $47, I aim to win the auction while minimizing payment. I'll bid slightly below my value to increase profit if I win. A bid of $44.9 should deter others from bidding higher without exceeding my value, maximizing potential profit.

Given my private value of $1, my goal is to minimize losses since winning would result in a net loss (paying more than the value I gain). Bidding $0 ensures I don’t win and incur losses, since any bid above $0 would exceed my value.
